sic_boundary.state: This file records the observable operational milestone state for the target project.
sic_boundary.intent: Project goals, milestone planning, and implementation documentation evaluation remain in project documents such as docs/vision.md, docs/architecture.md, and docs/milestones.md.
sic_boundary.control: Workflows and scripts validate this state before continuing the pipeline; this file does not execute work or define workflow logic.

notes: This file records operational milestone state only.
M1 is marked as completed because the foundation documents were consolidated for the renewed project vision and architecture.
M1 is locked to prevent implicit regression without an explicit reopen record.
M2 is marked as completed because the base Python structure and modular organization were prepared and validated for continuation.
M2 is locked to prevent implicit regression without an explicit reopen record.
M3 is the current active milestone and should be validated against docs/milestones.md before workflow continuation.
docs/milestones.md remains the planning document and must not be treated as the operational cursor.
docs/architecture.md may define the implementation documentation strategy; this file only records milestone state.
Issues, handoffs, workflows, and scripts may use this state as input for validation, but must not infer authorization to implement from this file alone.
This file should remain in the target project repository, preferably at docs/project-status/milestone-state.json.

documentation_boundary.implementation_documentation: Defined by docs/architecture.md and reflected by docs/milestones.md when applicable; not decided by this state file.
